messages:
leah: Heads-up — planning to migrate VIP entitlements from the legacy toggle-store to the new feature-flag service this week. Need a quick ops sync: contract gating + per-customer allowlist + canary audience.

marco: 👍 timeline? any downtime expected?

leah: No downtime. Goal is a gradual rollout: stage -> canary(3 customers) -> broad. Want to enforce contract ids so non-entitled orgs get 403.

ashley: Can we confirm product behavior for partial entitlements? e.g., org has some features in contract A but not B.

leah: Yes — plan is per-flag scope: flag metadata will include allowed_contracts: ["contract:ACME-2024", "contract:ZETA-ENT"]. Fallback path returns entitlement:false plus event log.

oliver: Two infra items: (1) routing from API layer to new flag-service (2) cache TTL for contract lookups. TTL set to 30s to allow quick revokes? Thoughts.

kim: Oncall concern: if TTL is too low we hit flag-service QPS spikes during bulk updates. Suggest 60s with a short write-through invalidation on policy change.

marco: Agreed with kim. Also need a safe fallback to legacy store if the new service is temporarily unavailable. Circuit breaker + degraded mode.

leah: Implementation notes I pushed to PR — quick snippet of the deployment flag CLI we will use for canary toggles:
```
# enable flag for specific orgs
ffctl set vip_entitlement --on --orgs org:acme org:beta-partner --reason "canary rollout"
# add contract gating
ffctl annotate vip_entitlement allowed_contracts contract:ACME-2024 contract:ZETA-ENT
```

ashley: Nice. Can product ops own the 3 canary orgs list? I'll coordinate with customer success to pick low-risk tenants.

leah: That would be great. Canaries I'm thinking: org:beta-partner, org:gamma-staging, org:internal-vip1.

kim: I'll add runbook entries for rollback and circuit-breaker thresholds. Quick checklist:
- Preflight: verify allowed_contracts mapping for each org
- Canary: enable for 3 orgs, monitor 200/403 ratio and latency
- Scale: expand to 25% of enterprise accounts in week 1
- Rollback: ffctl set vip_entitlement --off --all

oliver: For monitoring, we'll create a dashboard with: flag-service errors, cache hit ratio, per-org 403s, and per-flag eval latency. Tag metrics with project:vip-migration.

marco: Code review ping @leah — please add tests for contract parsing and a mock of the legacy fallback in the PR.

leah: On it, thanks. Also requesting an entitlement audit run prior to rollout — plan: run script to map current legacy toggles to contracts and surface mismatches.

flag-service-bot: Audit job queued: audit/vip-mapping-1768721100. Results posted to #eng-platform in ~20m.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Approve with `/deploy approve vip-migration` in this thread.

ashley: Approve from product side. /deploy approve vip-migration :thumbsup:

marco: Approve infra readiness.

kim: Oncall approved pending runbook link.

leah: Thanks everyone — will update PR and post runbook link once tests & audit complete. If you want to be added to the canary notify list, ping me.

marco: quick Q — who owns the customer communication if any VIP sees false negative?

ashley: CS owns outreach. If we detect entitlement mismatch for a live VIP, hold change and notify CS.

leah: Noted. I'll add guardrail that if any org with tag:vip gets 403 > 5 requests in 5m, auto-roll back.

oliver: Love that automated guardrail. Put it behind a feature flag so we can toggle the guardrail separately.

leah: Will do. End of thread for now — followups in PR.
